description: Schrack Technik NA96 96x96 mm network analyser with RS-485 Modbus RTU
source: Schrack Technik, Protocol Communication NA 96: Modbus Communication Protocol, section 4.0 Variables

sources.title: Schrack Technik, Protocol Communication NA 96: Modbus Communication Protocol
sources.version: undated, 18 pages; covers software versions below and from 1.09
sources.note: Section 4.0 Variables, word-addressed table at 0x1000 and footnotes 1 to 5; the table pages are images and were read by eye; copy on the Schrack Poland site

notes: Modbus RTU (the manual says MODBUS / JBUS compatible) on RS-485, half duplex, up to 32 instruments on a line, 8 data bits, 1 stop bit; baud rate and parity are programmable and no defaults are given. Functions used: 03 (read) and 16 (write).

Addresses are the word addresses of the manual's table at 0x1000 (and 0x1200), written as printed, address base 0. Registers are read with function 03; the manual does not say holding or input, so holding is used. Reads are limited to 100 bytes (50 registers) below software version 1.09 and 240 bytes from 1.09 on; max_read_registers is set to the lower limit.

'Long' values are two words, most significant word first, and 'WORD' values are one word (manual section 2.2), so byte and word order are big. The manual does not say whether values are signed; they are mapped as unsigned because the signs of powers are given in separate registers (0 = positive, 1 = negative).

Voltages are in mV and currents in mA in the manual and are scaled here to V and A. Power and energy units depend on the transformer ratios KTA and KTV (footnotes 3 and 4 of the manual) and are described in each register instead of a unit.

The manual lists a second table, addressed in bytes at 0x300 to 0x3EC and 0x100 to 0x104 (the earlier unofficial map used it), with the same quantities; it is not repeated here. The standard setup parameters (0x2000, 16 words) and the module setup areas for slots 1 to 3 (0x2100, 0x2200, 0x2300, 24 words each), which can be read and written from software version 1.09, are also not mapped.
The document is for the NA96 (the NA96+ and the Ethernet module have their own documents).
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
